what_to_detect: A Discover resolution with a discovered card: the last card exiled leaves exile for its owner's hand or for the stack (cast), rather than going to the bottom of the library with the rest. Why no family fits: A declaration on library-to-exile holds on both sides, since a resolution finding nothing also exiles. outcome_event's to_zone is one equality; a discovered card leaves exile for one of two zones, and either alone tags the other branch a near miss.
near_miss: A Discover resolution with no discovered card: every exiled card goes from exile to the bottom of the library and none to the hand or the stack.
